label: v_note titles + byte lengths
sql: SELECT slug, length(title) AS chars, length(CAST(title AS BLOB)) AS bytes, title, inbound, outbound, pagerank IS NULL AS pr_null FROM v_note WHERE slug NOT LIKE 'citer-%' ORDER BY slug

label: v_note longdesc cell
sql: SELECT slug, length(description) AS desc_chars, substr(description,1,40) AS head, substr(description,-60) AS tail FROM v_note WHERE slug='longdesc'

label: anchor inbound
sql: SELECT slug, inbound, outbound FROM v_note WHERE slug='anchor'

label: v_link full
sql: SELECT src, dst FROM v_link ORDER BY src

label: v_dangling full
sql: SELECT target, citing_notes, length(cited_by) AS cb_chars, cited_by FROM v_dangling ORDER BY target

label: v_note round-trip unicode via hex
sql: SELECT slug, hex(title) FROM v_note WHERE slug LIKE 'na%'

label: SELECT * FROM v_note whole vault
sql: SELECT * FROM v_note ORDER BY slug
